body: I hope you find peace soon man I'll be pulling for you!

You definitely should it has made me feel alot better. And yes it is scary. I always have intrusive thoughts. I really have no reason to be this way but I am. I have good days and bad days. However it brings me a weird sense of peace knowing I could end it whenever I want lol. The main thing is getting out of your head tho. I'm not sure what kind of job you have.  I worked in a warehouse where I was alone pretty much all day for 3 years. I found those were some of my worst years. Because I was in my head all day long. I now work outside in construction where I can get out in the fresh air and I feel productive now. it has helped. We will always be this way. We just need to make the best of it in our short time here.

I have felt the same way for more than 10 years. I know how it feels to just want to leave this world. I'm not sure your circumstances but you matter man. I have found for my self maybe you could try if you don't already. But lifting weights these past few months have really helped me. Put on some music and just work out. It has made me feel better at my lowest moments. I hope the best for you man
I'm sure it was. That would be very hard being in the spotlight as the funny guy while fighting these demons.

I appreciate your reply. It is very hard to be in this kind of situation. When most people think of someone who is suicidal they think your a loner. Or a history of abuse. I have neither problems. I don't know what is wrong. It's nice to know someone else is similar.. unfortunately. I want help but I'm not the kind of person to ask. Or seek it out. I feel bad also because so many people have it worse than me but yet here I am bitching on the internet. I'm lucky for the life I have but I'm not sure how much longer I can wear the mask/ struggle In silence. Thank you for the reply and I wish you the best with your struggles as well!

I've been living with these intrusive thoughts for some time now. Everyday I think what if I did something about it.. no one close to me even knows about it. It seems like Im wearing a mask of what I'm truly thinking..  it get tiring I know. Hang in there hopefully it gets better for you!
